checks.name: Compact initial focus retains Bow heading and selected button
Invalid typed preference rejects the pair without silently changing active effects
Unsupported settings bytes preserve current effects with visible error
Failed option write preserves corrupt bytes and active value
Explicit corrupt reset preserves original bytes in one backup
Repeated conflicts and cancellations never save or close the modal
Reopening after explicit reset loads actual default effect values
Normal key reset preserves real sound display and effect preferences

scope: Headless native input with actual effect receiver and isolated user settings. Explicit typed/unsupported corruption, rollback, backup reset, repeated conflict/cancel, compact initial focus and disposed capability. No renderer/OS input claim.
